definition: [ רָכַס ] verb bind (Assyrian rakâsu , id.; Late Hebrew found, lay foundation (rare); Arabic bind with [rope tying camel's head to forefoot] ( Frey ); but usually turn over, reverse ( Lane )); — Qal Imperfect 3 masculine plural יִרְכְּסוּ ( P ) Exod 28:28 , וַיִּרְכְּסוּ Exod 39:21 , bind חשֶׁן by ( מִן ) its rings to ( אֶל ) rings of ephod.

BDB7937 [H7405]

BDB7936 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB7938

[רָכַס] verb bind (Assyrian rakâsu, id.; Late Hebrew found, lay foundation (rare); Arabic bind with [rope tying camel's head to forefoot] (Frey); but usually turn over, reverse (Lane)); —

Qal Imperfect 3 masculine plural יִרְכְּסוּ (P) Exod 28:28, וַיִּרְכְּסוּ Exod 39:21, bind חשֶׁן by (מִן) its rings to (אֶל) rings of ephod.
